scope: Read-only audit of saved official-Training-only diagnostics. No official Test maps or accepted Radon artifacts used.
input_encoding: Known categorical die values decoded to 0/1/2, nearest resize to32, one-hot channels; inference matches saved reports exactly.

next_experiment.checkpoint: Keep an existing checkpoint fixed; no retraining needed for the first experiment.
next_experiment.split: Construct fresh mutually disjoint calibration and confirmation subsets from unused official Training maps. Explicitly include large/sparse None morphology strata. Reserve them before pseudo-labeling or resampling and exclude every saved train/validation/stress map. If a rare defect class has no unused maps, reuse an existing defect validation only for calibration and document that it is not independent confirmation for that class.
next_experiment.calibration: Select a single additive None-logit bias by macro F1 on calibration only, with a predetermined class prior or weights. Freeze the bias; report raw and calibrated predictions on the fresh confirmation subset without threshold retuning.
next_experiment.limits: This tests prior/calibration mismatch, not paper-equivalence. Current stress has informed the hypothesis and must remain descriptive. Do not calibrate with official Test labels or manufacture None rules from wafer size.

findings: Saved balanced validation contains no None maps with >=2500 active dies or <5% failed dies; it cannot detect these observed stress failure modes.
Training has only7/180 large None maps (>=2500 active dies), versus66/180 large Scratch maps. The two fixed models confuse93/101 and97/101 large stress None maps with Scratch.

All180 base training None,40 balanced validation None and3000 stress-extra None maps contain failed dies. None does not mean zero failed dies in this inventory; discarding defective None maps would corrupt supervision.

No saved stress/train/validation None or Scratch map loses all defect pixels on nearest resize. CPU predictions exactly reproduce both saved MPS confusion matrices; no evidence of a categorical encoding error.
Shape and sparse failed-die density correlate strongly with errors; this observational audit does not prove which learned feature caused them or establish an unbiased new score.

SMOTE is not the sole cause: fast_real has the same failure pattern. The existing random None-diversity ablation did not improve stress metrics; a morphology-covered validation/calibration split is needed before judging another training fix.
